modal.name: Name
modal.exposeAgentTitle: If enabled, the agent is callable as the tool agent_<name> from chat and from other agents: the main model delegates a task to it without seeing its internal tools (hierarchical delegation).
modal.exposeTeamTitle: If enabled, the team is callable as the tool team_<name> from chat: the main model delegates a task to it (hierarchical delegation).
modal.topologySupervisor: supervisor (one agent delegates to the others)
modal.toolPickerError: Could not load the available tools.
modal.toolPickerEmpty: No tools available. Configure MCP servers, skills, flows or other agents.
modal.toolPickerHint: {{count}} selected. Tick individual tools or a whole group.
modal.memoryContextText: Before each answer, the relevant memories from the episodic memory
modal.memoryContextTitle: If enabled, before each answer Recordare provides the user's memories relevant to the message (only relevant ones, at most ~300 tokens), appended at the end of the prompt: the agent can answer without calling a memory tool. Useful where latency matters (voice). Requires the user's episodic memory to be on.
